label: Chrome Futurism

traits.texture: smooth reflective silver shells, crisp specular edges and restrained iridescent reflections
traits.composition: translate the original forms into sleek metallic surfaces while preserving their main proportions and viewpoint
traits.lighting: cool environment reflections and controlled bright highlights against a spacious background

review_checks: Chrome reflections describe the original forms
The source silhouette and structural rhythm remain visible
Specular highlights avoid broad clipped patches
limitations: A contemporary chrome interpretation, not an art-historical reconstruction or a usable 3D material.
Palette, fine geometry and cross-image consistency require visual review; generation is not deterministic.
